description: Podcast prep PDF formatting was broken across multiple iterations this session. Root causes: (1) Harper rewrote the markdown structure when making edits rather than making targeted changes, (2) Master rebuilt the markdown from memory instead of diffing against a known-good example (Episode 8.md), (3) PDF was pushed to reMarkable before David had approved the output. Multiple push-and-fix cycles wasted David's time and trust. David rated this a massive fail.
correction: Before generating any podcast prep PDF: read a known-good example (Episode 8.md) line by line and match the structure exactly. Never push to reMarkable without explicit David approval when the output has already failed once. Present the PDF link and wait.
systemic_fix: Add to podcast-prep workflow: (1) diff output markdown against Episode 8.md structure before rendering PDF, (2) after any correction cycle, present PDF for approval before reMarkable push.
